name: Tilaknagar Inds.
why: Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 4.3 pts in a year
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit, annual profit
Margins shrinking (15% to 14%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 109 to 198, inventory days 191 to 319 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Weak (sales +160% YoY, profit -58% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 2.2 pts in a year
Promoter holding fell 5.6 pts in a year
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 85% to 86% of sales)

guidance: As promised, we have delivered on our guidance to introduce Imperial Blue in newer markets by reintroducing the brand in Delhi during July'26.
Looking ahead, we remain confident of improving upon the 15.5% baseline EBITDA margin achieved in Q4 FY26.
risks: The ongoing geopolitical tensions led to inflationary pressures across packaging inputs, particularly glass, resulting in a meaningful increase in packaging costs during the quarter.
Consequently, gross margins were under pressure.
focus: Focus on efficient capital deployment, disciplined debt management and working capital investments, facilitating the reduction of net debt-to-EBITDA below 1.0x by FY29 4.

Second question is like how we are planning in IB price segment where other brands have strengthened formulation and another brand is looking to grow at a faster scale, like ICONiQ White 50% growth for this year and McDo
And looking at the past of other domestic players, like they have been entering the premium space, plus they are also strengthening their back end.
